_comment: Trashlands: keep FTB Ultimine off the salvage terrain. Every block here is something a
worldgen feature piles up as a dig-for-scrap target, plus the ground those features sit on.
What stays vein-mineable is the rebuilt world - trees and crops off the reclamation ladder,
farmland, Nether stone, shard-crafted terrain, player builds.
Ultimine ships this tag empty, so replace:false appends rather than overwrites.
Add any new Recompile garbage block here when one lands.
